name: academic-ops-platform
description: Engineering College Academic Operations Platform - Governance-First

scripts.preinstall: node -e "if(!require('fs').existsSync('client')){console.error('\x1b[31m❌ Run npm install from the project ROOT, not from server/ or client/\x1b[0m');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.postinstall: if [ -z "$VERCEL" ] && [ -z "$NETLIFY" ]; then cd server && npx prisma generate; fi
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules client/.next server/dist && echo '✅ Cleaned. Run npm install to reinstall.'
